description: Merged Fabric client for Minecraft 1.21.11 - unifies three source clients under one ModuleManager and ClickGUI.

releases.notes: LightBaseFinder gains a LightEngine pass (krypton method): iterates the BLOCK light engine's stored nibble arrays directly across ALL loaded chunks instead of a radius cube — big base-finding recall boost. Reads the storage map by field-type reflection (no field-name mixin, falls back to the cube on any hiccup). Also includes 1.3.6's protocol version spoofer via ViaFabricPlus.

VersionSpoofer now spoofs the real protocol version via ViaFabricPlus (reflection, no hard dependency). Set Protocol to a version and reconnect — on a ViaVersion server (DonutSMP) the server registers you on that version and translates both ways. Off = native 1.21.11. Brand spoof unchanged.

VersionSpoofer (Client): rewrites the client brand sent to the server (ClientBrandRetriever.getClientModName) so a Fabric client can report vanilla/forge/etc instead of "fabric". Brand is sent on join — reconnect for a change to take effect.

Added SchematicBuilder (World) — an auto-printer for Litematica .litematic files.

Loads the newest (or a named) .litematic from the game's schematics/ folder, decodes regions + Litematica's long-straddling bit-packed block array, anchors at your feet on enable, and places any reachable missing block you have in your hotbar (reach-gated, throttled by BlocksPerTick). Cyan ghost shows pending targets; HUD shows progress.

MVP limits: hotbar-only (no auto inventory pull), no schematic rotation / property-exact matching, no GrimAC bypass, needs a solid neighbour to place against.

Ported Selene's STap + WTap to feClient (movement).

- **WTap** — taps forward off for a few ticks after an attack to reset sprint.
- **STap** — taps back on after an attack (reverse feel).
Both fire on the attack input (handSwinging rising edge). Settings: Chance, TapTicks, DelayTicks, OnlyOnGround, OnlyWeapon.
